name: Veracruz

plates.name: Current design (2026)
plates.fact: Veracruz's newest plate is white with a maroon (guinda) header reading VERACRUZ, a QR code, the state seal and the 'Por amor a Veracruz' heart logo along the bottom, and it is reported to carry an electronic security chip.

plates.name: Previous design (Dec 2018-2025)
plates.fact: Plates issued between December 2018 and December 2025 are exempt from the 2026 re-plating program, so this white QR-coded design with the national and state seals is still legal and very common.

plates.name: Older designs (issued up to Nov 2018), being phased out in 2026
plates.fact: Plates issued up to November 2018 (the white 2010-2016 rainbow-stripe design and the light-gray 2016-2018 design) must be swapped during 2026, so a few are still on the road until the program closes on Dec 31, 2026.

about: Veracruz plates to hunt, from the state's own sources on 2026-10-26. Not rated yet: every plate is worth the same.
